title: Dilip Goswami (Dharma and Management) — Incorruptible as a blueprint for a dharmic company
summary: Goswami is a deep tech founder and executive coach who writes the Dharma and Management newsletter on running a company by dharmic principles, sustaining benefit for everyone it touches. He set out to write an essay on how to build such a company, read Incorruptible, and wrote a review instead: a leader's values cannot carry the whole weight, because financial gravity acts on every successor and every board that follows.
blockquote: A founder’s values can not be the only load-bearing structure for the long-term character of a company. This structure has to be designed with the same seriousness with which one designs a product. And it has to be designed against something — against the gravity that will act on every successor, every future board, every future financial cycle.
blockquote_source: Dilip Goswami on LinkedIn (linking to his Dharma and Management essay)
